verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only the Marketing Emails API (creating, updating, and retrieving emails), not a Contacts API. Recipient exclusion appears only as a UI setting in the email editor. Nothing in the pack shows API-based contact creation, updating, suppression, custom properties, or production-scale limits and batching.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, update, and suppress contacts with custom properties through the API at production scale
